title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
lede: OpenAI released an image classifier for child sexual abuse material, built with NCMEC and free to select companies through its API, plus new ChatGPT deterrents for users who seek such content.

points: The classifier scores previously unseen images, including AI-generated ones, to help human reviewers prioritise.
In partner tests it flagged 48% fewer images while still finding the same number of abusive ones.
ChatGPT now shows a warning, points users to support services and suspends the account for 24 hours; repeat offences can mean removal.
OpenAI published guidance for developers on preventing, detecting and reporting CSAM to NCMEC.
Law enforcement gets AI investigative tools, plug-ins, training and a field guide, with access managed by program administrators.

sections.text: Developers shipping image features on OpenAI's platform get a ready-made detection and reporting path instead of building one, provided they qualify for classifier access.
